Representative sptPALM reconstruction/trajectory images, not an averaged quantification plot.

Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients pooled from all measured molecules (already showing full distribution); bottom is an overlay of individual mean-square-displacement traces per molecule, so no additional individual-point overlay is required.
Trajectory and kymograph panels display individual single-molecule trajectories directly, not an averaged summary plot.
